Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:10:1.english: What [does] "but" that it says [mean] - All the more so, for this is the reason that he prevents him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:10:2.hebrew: אלא - הכי קאמר: לפי שאינו דומה כו', וכיון דכך מנהג המקבלין, חבירו מעכב עליו. ואני שמעתי איפכא: אם בא בעל הבהמה לחלוק בתוך זמנו, המקבל מעכב עליו, לפי שאינו דומה טיפולה כו', שטיפול שנה ראשונה קשה משל שניה — מפני שהיא דקה, טיפולה מרובה להכניס ולהוציא, אבל טיפול השניה קל ושבחה מרובה. וקשיא לי: אי טיפולה של שניה קלה משל ראשונה, מאי לשון "חייב לטפל בה" דקתני רישא? משמע דעל כרחו חייב לטפל בה כל הזמן הזה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:10:2.english: Rather - This is what it is saying: "Because [the care] is not comparable," etc., and since such is the custom of those who accept [animals to raise], the other [party] prevents him [from dividing early]. However, I have heard the opposite: if the owner of the animal comes to divide within its [specified] time, the caretaker prevents him, "because its care is not comparable," etc. — for the care of the first year is harder than that of the second; since [the animal] is small, its care is extensive, [requiring one] to bring [it] in and take [it] out, whereas the care of the second [year] is light and its appreciation [in value] is great. Yet it is difficult for me: if the care of the second [year] is lighter than that of the first, what is [the meaning of] the expression "he is obligated to care for it" that the first clause teaches? It implies that against his will he is obligated to care for it all this time.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:11:1.hebrew: עד מתי חייב לטפל בולדות - שאף הן נחלקין למחצה, שהן שכר. והמקבל בא לומר, חלוק אותו מיד, שלא אעסוק בחלק שלך, שאיני נוטל בו כלום:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:11:1.english: Until when is he obligated to care for the offspring - For they too are divided in half, since they are profit; and the recipient [of the animal] comes to say, "Divide it immediately, so that I will not tend to your share, since I take nothing from it."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:11:2.hebrew: בדקה שלשים ובגסה חמשים - כדרך שפרט לך הכתוב בטיפול הבכור, שחייב ישראל לטפל בו בדקה שלשים ובגסה חמשים, ואח"כ נותנו לכהן, דיליף ליה בבכורות (דף כו:) מקראי:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:11:2.english: For a small [animal], thirty [days], and for a large [animal], fifty [days] - Just as Scripture specified for you regarding the care of the firstborn [animal], that an Israelite is obligated to care for it — for a small [animal] thirty [days] and for a large [animal] fifty [days] — and afterward gives it to the priest, as [the Gemara] derives it in Bekhorot (26b) from verses.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:11:3.english: Its teeth are thin - And it needs its mother and a person who is accustomed to this.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:11:4.hebrew: מכאן ואילך - יטול המקבל מחצה שלם בשביל חלקו, שהרי חציו שלו הן. ובמחצה השני של חבירו יטול מחצה בשבח, כדרך שנוטל באמה מחצית שכר, ושכר עמל ומזון ליכא. ואע"ג דחצי אחריות של מחצית חבירו עליו, כיון דבעי למיטרח בה משום מחצה שלו, שהוא קרן גמור ואינו מלוה, וכי טרח, משום דידיה קא טרח, ולא מיחזי כריביתא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:11:4.english: From this [point] forward - the recipient takes a full half for his share, since half of them are his. And of the second half, [which belongs] to his fellow, he takes half of the appreciation, just as he takes half the profit with [respect to] its mother, and there is no [separate] wage for labor and food. And even though half of the responsibility for his fellow's half is upon him, since he must toil with it on account of his own half — which is outright principal and not a loan — when he toils, he is toiling for his own [share], and it does not appear like interest.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:12:1.hebrew: מאן פלג לך - מי שם אותה? שמא לא נישומית יפה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:12:1.english: Who divided [it] for you - Who appraised it? Perhaps it was not appraised properly.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:12:2.hebrew: יגדילו - הולדות עד שיהו גדולים, ואינו נוטל בשל חבירו כלום:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:12:2.english: They should raise - the offspring until they are grown, and he does not take anything of his fellow's [share].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:1:1.hebrew: אי פלגא בהפסד - כלומר, פלגא בהפסד דכתב בשטרא, הכי קאמר: דאם ירצה רב עיליש, יטול תרי תילתי באגר ויקבל עליו חצי ההפסד, דאיכא שכר עמלו במאי דשקיל טפי באגרא ממה שמגיע לחלק פלגא דמלוה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:1:1.english: Or half in loss - That is to say, [the clause] "half in loss" that was written in the document means thus: that if Rav Ilish wishes, he shall take two-thirds of the profit and accept upon himself half of the loss, for there is compensation for his labor in that he takes more of the profit than what corresponds to the half share of the loan.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:2:1.hebrew: שיטה איתמר - הכי אמר רב נחמן: ר' יהודה ורבי יוסי בנו ורבן שמעון, כולן בשיטה אחת אמרו דבריהם:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:2:1.english: A [common] line of reasoning was stated - This is what Rav Nachman said: Rabbi Yehuda, Rabbi Yosei his son, and Rabban Shimon [ben Gamliel] — all of them stated their words in one line of reasoning.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:4:1.hebrew: מותר שליש בשכרך - השם עגל למחצה בשכר ובהפסד, ואמר לו: מה שיביא יותר על שליש דמיו של עכשיו, טול בשכרך, וכל השאר נחלוק בשוה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:4:1.english: The surplus over a third [is] your wages - One who appraises a calf for half [shares], in profit and in loss, and said to him: "Whatever it brings in beyond a third of its current value, take as your wages, and all the rest we will divide equally."

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:4:2.hebrew: מותר - דהא קיבל עליה מספק, ואע"ג דזימנין דליכא מותר שליש:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:4:2.english: [This is] permitted - For he accepted [it] upon himself despite the uncertainty, even though at times there is no surplus [over] one-third.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:5:1.hebrew: ריש עגלא לפטומא - המקבל עגל לפטמו למחצית, הראש יטול כולו לחלקו בשכר עמלו ומזונו, והשאר חולקין בשוה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:5:1.english: The head of the calf to the fattener - One who accepts a calf to fatten it for half [the profit] takes the entire head for his share as payment for his labor and its food, and the rest they divide equally.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:5:2.hebrew: מאי לאו דאמר ליה כו' - ואשמועינן רב דאי ליכא מותר שליש, נשקול ריש עגלא:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:5:2.english: What, is it not that he said to him, etc. - And Rav teaches us that if there is no surplus over one-third, he takes the head of the calf.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:6:1.hebrew: כי קאמר רב - הרי זה מותר, אע"ג דזמנין ליכא מותר שליש:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:6:1.english: When Rav says - This is permitted, even though sometimes there is no surplus over one-third.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:6:2.hebrew: כגון דאית ליה בהמות - למקבל, דיש עליו לטרוח לפני בהמותיו, ובשביל בהמה אחת עמהם אין טרחו נוסף:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:6:2.english: Where he has animals - [Referring] to the recipient, since he [already] has to toil for his [own] animals, and because of one [additional] animal with them, his toil is not increased.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:6:3.hebrew: דאמרי אינשי גביל לתורא גביל לתורי - באותו טורח שאתה מגבל סובין ושעורין לפני שור אחד, אתה יכול לגבל לפני שנים:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:6:3.english: As people say: Mix [feed] for an ox, mix for oxen - With the same effort that you mix bran and barley for one ox, you can mix [it] for two.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:7:1.english: And he gave [it] to his sharecropper - For a half [share] in profit and loss.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:7:2.hebrew: אי משתתפת בהדיה - אילו נתת חצי המעות והיית שותף בבהמה, היה נותן לך אף האליה כולה לחלקך:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:7:2.english: If you participate with him - If you had given half the money and been a partner in the animal, he would have given you the entire tail as well for your portion.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:7:3.hebrew: פלגיה לאליתא - כשבאו לחלוק, חלק רבי אלעזר את האליה:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:7:3.english: He divided the tail - When they came to divide [it], Rabbi Elazar divided the tail.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:7:4.english: He said to him - His sharecropper [said this].

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:7:5.english: Now, not even as initially? - Now will you not give [me] the entire head as you gave [it] at first?

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:8:1.hebrew: זוזי דידי הוו - וכי קבילת עלך פלגא בהפסד, הוו זוזי מלוה גבך:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:8:1.english: The money was mine - And when you accepted upon yourself half of the loss, the money was a loan in your possession.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:8:2.english: And had I not given you a little more - It would turn out that you are exerting yourself on the deposit half on account of the loan half.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:8:3.hebrew: דטרחתא טפי פורתא - להכניס ולהוציא, דאילו מזון, אם הוצרך לסובין או שעורין, קנית לאמצע כדרך שותפין:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:8:3.english: That you exert [yourself] a little more - [Namely,] to bring [the animal] in and take [it] out; for as for food, if it needed bran or barley, you bought [it] jointly, in the manner of partners.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:8:4.hebrew: לאתויי ליה רעיא - מרעה לבהמות, שאינו צריך לקנות בשוק, שיש עליו לטרוח בשבילו:
Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:8:4.english: To bring him pasture - Fodder for animals, which [the landowner] does not need to buy in the market, [as] it is incumbent upon [the sharecropper] to exert himself on his behalf.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:9:1.hebrew: בגודרות - בהמה דקה, לשון גדרות צאן (במדבר לב):
Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:9:1.english: For flocks - Small livestock; [an] expression [akin to] "sheepfolds [gidrot tzon]" (Numbers 32).

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:9:2.english: And if the recipient comes to divide - within this time.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:9:3.english: His fellow - The owner of the animal prevents him.

Rashi on Bava Metzia 69a:9:4.english: But the care of the first year is not comparable to the care of another year - For in the second [year] it requires more food than in the first.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 69a:2:1.hebrew: אלא שיטה איתמר - אומר ר"ת דמכ"מ הלכה כרשב"ג, דהא אמרינן (גיטין דף עה.): "כל מקום ששנה רשב"ג במשנתינו הלכה כמותו". ואין נראה, דהא רב ושמואל בעו או לקצוץ דינר או ריש עגלא לפטומא, ור' שמעון בן גמליאל לא בעי אלא גללים; וליכא למימר דהיינו דוקא בעגל עם אמו דלא נפיש טירחא, דהא ר' יוסי בר' יהודה אמר לעיל (בבא מציעא דף סח:) אפילו בבהמות גדולות דסגי בנסיובי ותותרי, דסבר לה כאבוה. וגם רבינו חננאל פירש דכל כי האי גוונא שנאמר "שיטה", לית הלכתא כחד מינייהו, אלא כרבי שמעון דאמר (שם): "נותן לו שכרו משלם":
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 69a:2:1.english: Rather, it was stated as a single opinion [shitah] - Rabbeinu Tam says that nevertheless the halakha is in accordance with Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel, for we say (Gittin 75a): "Wherever Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel taught in our Mishnah, the halakha is in accordance with him." However, this does not appear [correct], for Rav and Shmuel require either stipulating a dinar or [giving him] the head of a calf for fattening [it], whereas Rabban Shimon ben Gamliel requires only the dung; and one cannot say that this applies specifically to a calf with its mother, where the effort is not great, for Rabbi Yosei, son of Rabbi Yehuda, said above (Bava Metzia 68b) even regarding large animals that whey and pluckings suffice, as he holds like his father. And Rabbeinu Chananel also explained that in any case like this where "a single opinion [shitah]" is stated, the halakha does not follow any one of them, but rather [follows] Rabbi Shimon, who says (there): "He gives him his wage in full."

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 69a:4:1.hebrew: אמר רב מותר שליש בשכרך מותר - וא"ת: והא צד אחד ברבית הוא, דשמא לא ימצא מותר שליש, ורב לית ליה דר' יהודה דשרי צד אחד ברבית, דאמר לעיל (בבא מציעא דף סג.): "עושין אמנה בפירות, ואין עושין אמנה בדמים", ומשמע לעיל דהיינו דלא כרבי יהודה? ועוד, דאפילו לרבי יהודה לא שרי בכי האי גוונא, אלא כשיש ביד לוה או מלוה לעשות צד אחד שלא יהיה רבית? ויש לומר, דהכא אקילו רבנן משום דשכיחי טובא שיהא מותר שליש:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 69a:4:1.english: Rav says: "The surplus over one-third is your wages" — [this] is permitted - And if you ask: Isn't this [a case of] one-sided interest, for perhaps there will not be a surplus over one-third, and Rav does not hold like Rabbi Yehudah, who permits one-sided interest — for [Rav] said above (Bava Metzia 63a): "One may make an amanah [advance-payment] arrangement for produce, but one may not make an amanah arrangement for money," and it is implied above that this is not in accordance with Rabbi Yehudah? And furthermore, even according to Rabbi Yehudah, he does not permit [it] in such a case, [but] only when it is in the power of the borrower or the lender to bring about the one side where there will be no interest? And one can say that here the Sages were lenient because it is very common for there to be a surplus over one-third.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 69a:6:1.hebrew: דאמרי אינשי גביל לתורא גביל לתורי - וא"ת: מהאי טעמא לשתרי אפילו לית ליה בהמה לדידיה, דהא צריך לטרוח לעצמו משום פלגא דמלוה? וי"ל דלא דמי, דאי לית ליה בהמה לדידיה אין צריך לטרוח בבהמה של שותפות בכל יום, אלא כל אחד יטרח ביומו:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 69a:6:1.english: As people say: Mix [food] for an ox, mix for oxen - And if you ask: For this reason, let it be permitted even if he does not have an animal of his own, since he needs to exert himself for his own sake on account of the half [that is] a loan? One can answer that it is not comparable, for if he does not have an animal of his own, he does not need to exert himself with the partnership animal every day; rather, each one [of the partners] will exert himself on his [own] day.

Tosafot on Bava Metzia 69a:7:1.hebrew: אי משתתפת בהדיה יהיב לך נמי אליתא - תימה, למה היא סבורה כן? דהא כי משתתף בהדיה נמי ויטול כל הראש, הרי הוא כבתחלה; דמתחלה, שהיה טורח בכל הבהמה של ר' אלעזר, היה נוטל הראש, ועכשיו, שטורח לרבי אלעזר רק בחצי בהמה, יטול חצי הראש מחלק רבי אלעזר. ועוד, מאי קאמר "השתא שותפי אנן"? והלא גם עתה היתה חלקו של רבי אלעזר פלגא מלוה! ויש לומר, דכשנשתתף עמו היה טורח בחציו של רבי אלעזר בחנם, ועל כן אמרה "יהיב לך נמי אליתא", אחרי שאינך לוקח מחלקו שום שכר:
Tosafot on Bava Metzia 69a:7:1.english: "If you partner with him, he will also give you the tail" - [This is] puzzling: why did she think so? For even when he partners with him and takes the entire head, it is [merely] as it was initially! For initially, when he was tending the entire animal of Rabbi Elazar, he would take the head, and now, when he is tending for Rabbi Elazar only half the animal, he should take half the head from Rabbi Elazar's portion [with the other half being his own]. Furthermore, what does he mean [by saying], "Now we are partners"? After all, even now Rabbi Elazar's portion was half a loan! And one can answer that when he partnered with him, he was tending Rabbi Elazar's half for free, and therefore she said, "He will also give you the tail," since you are not taking any wages from his portion.
